candidates.requirement: Link jq_fuzz_execute against the Oniguruma archive produced by the repository's bundled build.
candidates.target_route: build.sh configures bundled Oniguruma, runs make, then links jq_fuzz_execute with an archive named under modules/oniguruma.
candidates.failure_condition: The linker input modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a does not match the bundled library's vendor/oniguruma build path, so the target link fails before any fuzz input can execute.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete target link command provides no alternate Oniguruma archive path; the supplied build rules use vendor/oniguruma.
